characterization.cause: HttpListener.Start fails after a loopback port collision and disposes the object. The catch handler then accesses listener.Prefixes, masking the original bind error and preventing retry.

The isolated shell supplies TERM=dumb. TerminalColorMode correctly disables color before checking COLORTERM, so the RGB checkpoint never appears. The visual fixture inherited an incompatible terminal type.

implementation: Close the failed listener without accessing its disposed Prefixes. Every retry uses a new listener and port; the first-port parameter provides deterministic collision injection in test infrastructure. The regression holds an occupied TCP port, checks fallback to a different port and completes an actual HTTP request.
The theme PTY fixture explicitly sets TERM, COLORTERM and PI_TRUE_COLOR, clears NO_COLOR, and uses offline catalog startup. Its assertions and original 12-second deadline remain unchanged.
